angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 528,732 km at 194.92 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.1302 +/- 0.0160 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 194.92 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.76 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Frensch et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2989 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract): 528,732 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.77 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Frensch et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2989 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4672 +/- 170 K from Frensch et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2989 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Frensch et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2989 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2989.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.563, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2989 (pscomppars): spectral type K4 V, from Frensch et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-2989: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2989 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.04 dex, from Frensch et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2989 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.73755, from Frensch et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2989 (pscomppars): rotation period 30 d, from Frensch et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2989 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Frensch et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...700A.118F/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
